response.hostage_policy: Hostages are managed, never panicked. A losing layer keeps its wide structural stop and stays in the field while the hunt continues on the other symbols; fresh small wins are spent first to release the deepest hostage (bank a TP1 elsewhere and cut the worst layer against it), otherwise hold and let time work while the entry structure is intact. Circuit breakers: stop deploying new armies at -10% of the 2,500 collateral (-250); hard floor -16% (-400) - cut down to that bound and stand down for the week. Early release only if the daily structure invalidates (a close beyond the stop zone) or the thesis is gone: BTC below 79,300, ZEC below 1,090, WLD below 0.462, NEAR below 4.48, HYPE above 84. Maximum four concurrent armies of roughly 1,250 notional each, same fixed RP every time - never revenge-size, never widen a stop to avoid being wrong.
response.rationale: TSM Principle #1 frames the whole week: Control Risk, Limit Resources, Wait & See. Market read: BTC is consolidating 79.7k-84.9k after the 64k-to-84k weekly advance, sitting mid-range under the daily EMA20 (82.7k) with a rising EMA50 (80.8k); the majors (ETH, SOL, XRP) are all below their EMAs while a minority of alts shows genuine relative strength, and current marks sit 2-6% under the last daily closes - the market is already pulling back toward my levels. So this is a Zero Alpha week: no direction prediction, only pre-planned action points where nobody expects price to be rewarded - BTC anchor long at the EMA50 shelf, ZEC (+14.6% 7d) pullback long into the EMA50/weekly-VWAP confluence at 1,180-1,215, WLD (+27% 30d) trend-pullback long into its rising EMA20, NEAR (+23% 30d) EMA20 retest long, plus one deliberate counter-weight in HYPE shorted into its declining EMA cap so the book is not pure long crypto beta. Sizing: 5,000 notional on the 2,500 reallocated collateral = 2x leverage, far below every watchlist symbol's max leverage (minimum 10x across the list); four armies of about 1,250 notional with wide structural stops put the all-wrong worst case near -400, about -4% of the 10,000 free equity, so the main army survives any realistic bad week. The goal is a steady flow of small hostages - bank TP1s early, let TP2s run - not a home run; unfilled entries simply mean a small, safe week.
